subject: gk
question: Which of the following is the correct full form of CACP?

options.text: Chamber of Agro Chemicals and Pesticides
Centre for Agricultural Commission and Prices
Commission for Agricultural Costs and Prices
Centre for Agricultural costs and Policies

solution:
The correct answer is **__Commission for Agricultural Costs and Prices__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **CACP **stands for Commission for Agricultural Costs and Prices.
 
• It is a statutory body formed under** Agriculture Price Commission Act, 1962**.
 
• It is an attached office of the **Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India, which came into existence in January 1965.​**
 
• It comprises **a body of 5 people a Chairman, Member Secretary, one Member (Official), and two Members (Non-Official).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**Roles and Responsibilities of CACP**

 
• It provides an assurance of a stable price environment to the farmers.
 
• It helps them to obtain a f**air price for their crops, even in the unstable market situation**, hence preventing them from falling into the vicious cycle of debt. 
 
• The Government sets the** MSPs** on the basis of the recommendations given by this committee.
 
• The CACP recommends the MSPs for** 23 commodities, which include seven grains, five pulses, seven oilseeds, and four commercial crops.**
